rules.question: Does a fill or an end choice cost nothing, so the Path Builder calls it "best"?
rules.owner: app::costs_nothing in src/app/path_costs.cpp, the one test for a cost that loses nothing
rules.decision: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-30-path-builder-redesign.md, "Engine truth": the best next fill always costs 0; found by the PB-5 review
rules.note: Whether a choice loses nothing is asked once, in costs_nothing; the screen's "best" labels, its best-fill lookups and pb_text's cost label and fill card line all call it. cost_tier's own throw on a negative cost and its test for exactly 0 are the tier rule, not this question, and the pattern does not match them.
